## **Bugs et stabilité** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      4 avis récents mentionnent bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 23 sept. 2026 - 10 oct. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _I C_, 10 oct. 2026, 1/5: "I would love to love this app, unfortunately it simply doesn't work on my phone. I crashes when I try to create a new document and it crashes when I try to open one too. What a shame :("
            2. _Mein Name_, 3 oct. 2026, 1/5: "completely useless if in spreadsheets lines do not stick together when sorting. It's also buggy as hell. When I tap "freeze row" nothing happens. And for some reason it keeps overwriting while I am typing. a complete mess but I would have still used it if I could sort my data correctly."
            3. _Monitor ePublications AR_, 25 sept. 2026, 2/5: "Won't open password protected files as of 9-26, prior to that usually stable. Known new issue, awaiting fix."
<!--/ir-theme-->
